hero.title: Certifications
hero.description: International certifications are evidence of our commitment to maintaining quality standards, safety, and sustainable development throughout the metal packaging production process.

iso.title: ISO 9001:2015
iso.desc: Operating procedures are standardized from raw material input to finished products, ensuring consistent quality.

fssc.title: FSSC 22000 Ver 6.0
fssc.desc: International food safety standards, risk control, and ensuring products meet strict requirements.

haccp.title: HACCP
haccp.desc: HACCP is a preventive approach food safety management system, focusing on hazard identification and control at critical control points (CCP) throughout the food contact packaging production process.

control.title: Quality Control
control.desc: High-precision automated measurement system, controlling tolerances at the micron level for each batch of 2-piece and 3-piece cans.

safety.title: Food Safety
safety.desc: Internal coating complies with safety standards, BPA-free, ensuring compatibility for food and beverages.

compliance.title: Standard Compliance
compliance.desc: Full compliance with technical requirements and international trade regulations for exported metal packaging.

cta.title: Ready to elevate your product standards?
cta.description: Delta Seikan accompanies businesses in meeting strict requirements for quality, safety, and export capability.
